import sys
from collections import namedtuple

def main():
    Employee = namedtuple('Employee', ['name', 'age', 'salary'])
    
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    employees = []
    
    for _ in range(n):
        parts = sys.stdin.readline().split()
        name = parts[0]
        age = int(parts[1])
        salary = float(parts[2])
        employees.append(Employee(name, age, salary))
    
    for emp in employees:
        print(f"Name: {emp.name}, Age: {emp.age}, Salary: {emp.salary:.2f}")
    
    max_employee = max(employees, key=lambda x: x.salary)
    print(f"Highest Salary -> Name: {max_employee.name}, Age: {max_employee.age}, Salary: {max_employee.salary:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
